qe: If in a certain code language, FLOWER is written as UOLDVI, then how TERMINAL will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी निश्चित कूट भाषा में FLOWER को UOLDVI लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में TERMINAL को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Direct Opposite Letter Pairs Shortcut):
Step 1: 'FLOWER' ke opposite pairs check karein (Sum of positions = 27):
- F ↔ U (Four)
- L ↔ O (Love)
- O ↔ L (Love)
- W ↔ D (Dew)
- E ↔ V (Evening)
- R ↔ I (Indian Railway)
Logic: Sabhi letters ke sammukh (opposite) aksharon ko seedhe kram (forward order) me likha gaya hai.
Step 2: 'TERMINAL' ke opposite letters nikalein:
- T ↔ G (GT Road)
- E ↔ V (EVening)
- R ↔ I (Indian Railway)
- M ↔ N (MAN)
- I ↔ R (Indian Railway)
- N ↔ M (MAN)
- A ↔ Z (A to Z)
- L ↔ O (LOve)
Code: GVINRMZO.
Correct option (B) GVINRMZO hai.

Method 2 (First Letter Elimination Method):
T ka opposite letter 'G' hota hai ($27 - 20 = 7$). Chaaron vikalpon me se keval Option (B) 'G' se shuru ho raha hai, baaki teeno vikalp turant eliminate ho jate hain.
Sahi uttar (B) hai.

qe: If in a certain code language, KING is written as TMRP, then how RAIL will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी निश्चित कूट भाषा में KING को TMRP लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में RAIL को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Opposite Letter Shortcut):
Step 1: 'KING' ka reverse opposite pattern dekhein:
- G(aakhiri letter) ka opposite T (1st code)
- N ka opposite M (2nd code)
- I ka opposite R (3rd code)
- K(pehla letter) ka opposite P (Last code)
Logic: Word ke letters ko ulte kram (reverse order) me lekar unke opposite letters likhe gaye hain.
Step 2: 'RAIL' par same reverse opposite pattern lagayein:
- L(last letter) ka opposite O (1st code)
- I ka opposite R (2nd code)
- A ka opposite Z (3rd code)
- R(first letter) ka opposite I (4th code)
Code: ORZI.
Correct option (D) ORZI hai.

Method 2 (Option Elimination by First & Last Letter):
- Aakhiri letter 'L' ka opposite 'O' sabse aage aayega, isliye Options (A) aur (C) eliminate ho gaye.
- Pehle letter 'R' ka opposite 'I' aakhiri me aayega, Option (B) me aakhiri me 'I' hai lekin 1st letter 'R' galat hai. Keval Option (D) bachta hai.
Sahi uttar (D) hai.

qe: If in a certain code language, HAND is written as ZSWM, then how SILK will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में HAND को ZSWM लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में SILK को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (2-Letter Cross Opposite Pattern Method):
Step 1: 'HAND' ko 2-2 letters ke pairs me cross karein:
- Pair 1 (H A): A ka opposite Z, H ka opposite S → 'ZS'
- Pair 2 (N D): D ka opposite W, N ka opposite M → 'WM'
Combined: ZS + WM = ZSWM.
Logic: 2-letter pairs me aapas me cross karke opposite letters likhe gaye hain.
Step 2: 'SILK' par apply karein:
- Pair 1 (S I) cross opposite:
  - I ka opposite R
  - S ka opposite H
  → 'RH'
- Pair 2 (L K) cross opposite:
  - K ka opposite P
  - L ka opposite O
  → 'PO'
Combined Code: RH + PO = RHPO.
Correct option (A) RHPO hai.

Method 2 (Fast Option Elimination):
- Pehle pair me 'I' ka opposite 'R' pehle sthan par aayega, isliye 'H' se shuru hone wale Options (C) aur (D) eliminate ho gaye.
- Aakhiri letter 'L' ka opposite 'O' aayega, isliye Option (B) eliminate ho gaya (jisme 'P' last me hai). Keval Option (A) sahi hai.
Sahi uttar (A) hai.

qe: Find the odd one out : (A) IR, (B) MN, (C) GT, (D) KC
qh: विषम को चुनिए : (A) IR, (B) MN, (C) GT, (D) KC
e:
Method 1 (Opposite Pair Identification Shortcut):
Step 1: Pratyek vikalp ke aksharon ka sambandh check karein:
- (A) I ↔ R : Indian Railway (Opposite letter pair, $9 + 18 = 27$)
- (B) M ↔ N : MAN (Opposite letter pair, $13 + 14 = 27$)
- (C) G ↔ T : GT Road (Opposite letter pair, $7 + 20 = 27$)
- (D) K ↔ C : K ka opposite P hota hai ($11 + 3 = 14 \ne 27$)
Step 2: Pehle teeno vikalp opposite letter pairs hain, jabki chautha vikalp (KC) opposite pair nahi hai.
Correct option (D) KC hai.

Method 2 (Positional Sum Method):
- Sum A: $9 + 18 = 27$
- Sum B: $13 + 14 = 27$
- Sum C: $7 + 20 = 27$
- Sum D: $11 + 3 = 14 \ne 27$ (Odd one out).
Sahi uttar (D) hai.

qe: If in a certain code language, DIAMOND is written as VQYMKLV, then how FEMALE will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में DIAMOND को VQYMKLV लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में FEMALE को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Opposite Letter - 1 Shortcut Method):
Step 1: 'DIAMOND' ka pattern decode karein:
- D ↔ W(23) → 23 - 1 = 22 (V)
- I ↔ R(18) → 18 - 1 = 17 (Q)
- A ↔ Z(26) → 26 - 1 = 25 (Y)
- M ↔ N(14) → 14 - 1 = 13 (M)
- O ↔ L(12) → 12 - 1 = 11 (K)
- N ↔ M(13) → 13 - 1 = 12 (L)
- D ↔ W(23) → 23 - 1 = 22 (V)
Logic: Har letter ka Opposite letter nikal kar usme se 1 ghataya (-1) gaya hai.
Step 2: 'FEMALE' par same logic lagayein:
- F ↔ U(21) → 21 - 1 = 20 (T)
- E ↔ V(22) → 22 - 1 = 21 (U)
- M ↔ N(14) → 14 - 1 = 13 (M)
- A ↔ Z(26) → 26 - 1 = 25 (Y)
- L ↔ O(15) → 15 - 1 = 14 (N)
- E ↔ V(22) → 22 - 1 = 21 (U)
Code: TUMYNU.
Correct option (A) TUMYNU hai.

Method 2 (Positional Difference Method):
Rule: Code = $(27 - \text{Position}) - 1 = 26 - \text{Position}$.
- F(6) → 26 - 6 = 20 (T)
- E(5) → 26 - 5 = 21 (U)
- M(13) → 26 - 13 = 13 (M)
- A(1) → 26 - 1 = 25 (Y)
- L(12) → 26 - 12 = 14 (N)
- E(5) → 26 - 5 = 21 (U)
Pehle letter 'T' se sirf Option (A) shuru ho raha hai (Options B, C, D bahar).
Sahi uttar (A) hai.
